messages:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a small launch for the 'Starter Sandbox' tutorial + mini-demo next week. Goal: quick onboarding for devs, show low-effort benchmarks, and capture inbound signups. Who can own copy + webinar ops?
Sam: I can take copy + landing CTA. will draft a short hero and 2 tweet variants.
Julian: I can do the mini-demo video (2-3 min) and a 1-page step-by-step for the repo. Need a script by Tue.
Cleo: I'll own the benchmark narrative + numbers. thinking: simple cost/latency comparison vs vanilla CPU inference, and a 'what this unlocks' bullet list.
Maya: perfect. timeline: draft assets by Tue EOD, internal review Wed, soft-launch (blog + repo) Thu, webinar Fri. Sounded tight but doable? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Sam: tight but yes. for tweets I'll use two tones: 1) quick win (copy below), 2) community invite (workshop style).
Sam: ```Tweet A: Getting started with Redwood Starter Sandbox — 5 min quickstart, live demo, and low-cost benchmark results. Join the mini-demo & grab the repo: https://rwd.co/starter-sandbox :rocket:
Tweet B: Hands-on workshop: build a tiny chat + see perf numbers. Free sandbox, open-source repo, quickstart guide. RSVP: https://rwd.co/sandbox-rsvp :calendar:
```
Cleo: Benchmark plan (short): run 3 workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings) at seq=256, batch sizes 1/4/16. Use model variants: open-llm-small, rw-small-quant. Key metric: median latency, tokens/sec, and cost per 1k tokens. I can produce a 1-slide summary + CSV.
Julian: For demo script: start with `git clone` and `pip install -r requirements.txt`, then run a single `python demo.py` — keep it resilient to missing GPU. I'll add fallback instructions.
Maya: inbound lead routing: Sam, suggest we gate the webinar RSVP with email only + hidden UTM so we can route leads into HubSpot list "starter-sandbox-webinar" and a Marketo campaign. Also add a post-signup microflow: welcome email w/ repo + 1-click calendar.
Sam: agree. I'll add hidden fields: source=starter_sandbox, campaign=ss-launch-2026, utm_medium=social.
Cleo: For the benchmark narrative copy, I'll include a single line like: "Starter Sandbox trims inference cost by ~3x vs naive CPU setups at 95th pct latency parity". Will validate numbers before publish.
Julian: Video notes — we'll keep it screen-only, captioned, and include a short terminal clip showing the benchmark command: 
```bash
python bench.py --model rw-small-quant --seq 256 --batch 4 --out metrics.csv
```
Sam: Draft landing hero (first pass): "Starter Sandbox — a 5-minute path to production-grade inference. Repo, demo, and a tiny benchmark you can run locally." Short CTA: "Try the sandbox" + secondary "Watch mini-demo".
Maya: Also think about community sequencing: post the repo to Discussions + pin a 'getting started' thread in #community. We'll run a 1-hour office hours after the webinar next Mon.
Cleo: QA checklist for publish: validate numbers, smoke test demo steps on CPU-only, make sure the README has conda & pip variants, verify license headers for OSS components.
Maya: Ops notes: Julian — can you upload the mini-demo to S3 and share the public link by Wed noon? We'll embed in the landing page.
Julian: yes. will do.
devrel-bot: Reminder: content freeze for marketing assets starts Wed 12:00 UTC. Please tag with `@marketing-review` before then.
Sam: I'll post the first draft here by Mon afternoon for quick feedback.
Maya: thanks team. small, focused launch — aim for high signal, low friction. :white_check_mark:
